Definition: from G1640; to diminish, i.e. fall short:--have lack.
BiblicalUsage: elattonéō turns up where the Bible says to fall short, to have lack. In 2 Corinthians 8:15, the text says "and he that [had gathered] little had no lack."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of elattonéō I do not force more than it gives: to fall short, to have lack.
